comparison.objective: Retrieve an out-of-reach jar by moving its supporting board, then place the jar in a basket.
comparison.physical_skill: Use indirect support pulling followed by ordinary jar pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: The released jar rests still in the basket; partial credit only requires bringing it within reach.
comparison.reason: Indirect retrieval has no precision adjustment, rotational counterholding, threaded locking, or functional-cycle test.
